Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'repeated_modules', 'completionRule': '按可见座宽向右侧延伸对应座位单元'} and ['补全被遮挡的沙发右侧部分']. Texture rule: 细腻短绒织物纹理; 延续米白布艺纹理，保持质感统一. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
